library(shiny)
library(randomForest)

# 1. Force the app to look in the current directory
setwd(getwd())

# 2. Load Model & Dataset (These MUST be in the same folder as app.R)
# If files are in C:\FintechApp, this will work perfectly now
model <- readRDS("bnpl_credit_risk_model.rds")
bnpl_dataset <- read.csv("bnpl_dataset.csv") 

# 3. UI Layout
ui <- navbarPage(
  title = "BNPL Credit Risk Portal",
  
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
      body { background-color: #f4f7f6; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
      .custom-card { background-color: white; padding: 30px; border-radius: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); margin-bottom: 20px; }
      h1, h3 { color: #003366; font-weight: bold; }
      .btn-primary { background-color: #003366 !important; border-color: #003366 !important; width: 100%; padding: 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; }
      .navbar { background-color: #003366 !important; }
      .navbar-default .navbar-nav > li > a { color: white !important; }
  "))),
  
  tabPanel("Home", fluidPage(div(class = "custom-card", 
      h1("Welcome to BNPL Risk Assessment"),
      p("Specialized ML tool for Automated Credit Risk Assessment."),
      hr(),
      h3("Project Overview"),
      p("Predicting borrower repayment behavior using Random Forest.")
  ))),
  
  tabPanel("Risk Assessment",
           sidebarLayout(
             sidebarPanel(
               class = "custom-card",
               h4("Enter User Details"),
               numericInput("customer_age", "Customer Age:", value = 25),
               selectInput("gender", "Gender:", choices = c("Male", "Female")),
               numericInput("annual_income", "Annual Income:", value = 50000),
               numericInput("credit_score", "Credit Score:", value = 700),
               selectInput("purchase_cat", "Purchase Category:", choices = c("Electronics", "Clothing", "Home", "Other")),
               selectInput("device_type", "Device Type:", choices = c("Mobile", "Desktop", "Tablet")),
               actionButton("predict_btn", "Evaluate Risk", class = "btn-primary")
             ),
             mainPanel(
               div(class = "custom-card", 
                   h3("Assessment Result"),
                   verbatimTextOutput("prediction_output")
               )
             )
           )
  )
)

# 4. Server Logic
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  result <- eventReactive(input$predict_btn, {
    
    # We map user inputs to the model's schema.
    # Note: Using 'levels()' from bnpl_dataset ensures the factor levels match exactly.
    new_data <- data.frame(
      Customer_Age.x = as.numeric(input$customer_age),
      Gender.x = factor(input$gender, levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Gender.x))),
      Annual_Income.x = as.numeric(input$annual_income),
      Credit_Score.x = as.numeric(input$credit_score),
      Purchase_Category.x = factor(input$purchase_cat, levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Purchase_Category.x))),
      Device_Type = factor(input$device_type, levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Device_Type))),
      
      # Backend Defaults (To ensure 13-feature input)
      BNPL_Provider.x = factor("Provider_A", levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$BNPL_Provider.x))),
      Purchase_Amount.x = 1000, 
      Income_Bracket = factor("Medium", levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Income_Bracket))),
      Connection_Type = factor("WiFi", levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Connection_Type))),
      Checkout_Time_Seconds = 30,
      Browser = factor("Chrome", levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Browser))),
      Cluster = factor("Cluster_1", levels = levels(as.factor(bnpl_dataset$Cluster)))
    )
    
    predict(model, new_data)
  })
  
  output$prediction_output <- renderPrint({
    final_pred <- result()
    if(final_pred == 1) "Result: HIGH RISK - Default Probability Detected" 
    else "Result: LOW RISK - Loan Approved"
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
